# 1. Objective

**Widget Exporter** — Operators cannot export widget lists to CSV today.

## 1.1. Value Proposition

Customers need one-click CSV export from the widget list without manual copy-paste.

## 1.4. Implementation Phases

Phase 1: toolbar export button and CSV download for visible columns.

# 5. Product Feature Requirements

## 5.1. Functional Requirements

### 5.1.1. Export CSV (Phase 1)

The product MUST add an "Export CSV" button to the widget list toolbar.
The exported file MUST match visible column order.

# 7. Product Non-Requirements

- XLSX export is out of scope for this initiative.
- Scheduled bulk exports are not supported.
